bio.text: Elexie Moore has served in the Alaska House of Representatives for District 28 since 2025.

According to Moore's legislative biography, the representative lists Anchorage (1987 to 2000), Palmer (2000 to 2016) and Wasilla (2016 to present) among the Alaska communities lived in, and says Moore has worked as a real estate professional since 2015.
Moore says in the biography that Moore and Luke Moore have six children.
